title: The 16 best AI video generators in 2026
summary: We tested dozens of AI video generators, and these are the best tools to create, edit, and enhance videos using AI.
body_markdown:
****


**Category**


**Best for**


**Pricing**


Google Veo


AI video generator


Creating reliable, high-quality videos from prompts or images


Free credits monthly; $4.99/month for Plus with 200 credits; $19.99/month for Pro with 1,000 credits


Runway


AI video generator


Cinematic, film-style video creation and advanced generative editing


Free plan with limited credits; Standard plan at $12/month with more credits, no watermark, and higher export quality


LTX Studio


AI video generator


Extreme creative control with shot-by-shot storyboarding


Free trial with credits; Lite plan at $12/month with higher monthly credits


Adobe Firefly


AI video generator


Commercially safe AI video generation


Free limited generations; Firefly Standard at $9.99/month for credits and full AI access (IP indemnification requires proper plan)


Descript


AI video editor


Editing video by editing the script


Free plan with limited transcription; Hobbyist plan at $16/user/month removes watermark and boosts export quality


Wondershare Filmora


AI video editor


Polishing videos with AI tools in a traditional editor


Free limited plan; paid plans start at $69.99/year, with AI credits in higher tiers


VEED


AI video editor


Faster content production and repurposing


Free plan with watermark; Creator plan at $12/month removes watermark and increases export quality


Capsule


AI video editor


Streamlining enterprise video production workflows


Contact for pricing


Eddie AI


AI video editor


Getting a rough cut from long footage in minutes


Pay-as-you-go pricing, starting at $10 for 1,000 credits (about an hour of footage) and $45 for 5,000 credits.


OpusClip


AI video editor


Extracting viral clips from long-form video


Free plan with monthly credits and watermark; Starter plan at $15/month removes watermark and unlocks advanced tools


invideo AI


AI video creation suite


Creating social media videos from a prompt


From $10/seat/month (billed annually); $30/seat/month unlocks frontier AI models


Vyond


AI video creation suite


Creating animated character videos from prompts


Free trial with watermarked output; paid plans start at $58/month


Synthesia


AI video creation suite


Creating videos with realistic digital avatars


Free plan with limited credits; Starter plan at $14/month with more video time and avatar features


LiveAvatar by HeyGen


AI video creation suite


Interactive, real-time digital avatars


Free plan with limited credits; Essential plan at $99/month with higher limits and unlimited users


revid.ai


AI video creation suite


Using AI-powered templates for social content


Free plan with limited features and no exports; Hobby plan at $39/month


Pictory


AI video creation suite


Transforming existing content into polished videos


Plans start at $25/month; higher tiers increase video and transcription limits
